folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: chance-fit map scope, 2026-11-04 (B359)
folds.body:
LSD335–LSD387 is a complete53-row map; the reported38 relevant-module rows equal71.7percent after rounding. Relevance is not implemented semantic depth, native reachability, source calibration or completion. The21 golden cases are a historical retained-case claim, not newly run tests. P1–P8/EP6 and GR/SB links route proposed work; they do not assign current writers or require every phase before a useful slice.

Preserve its narrow separations: addressed draws versus frozen revealed truth; author inspector versus earned character perception; chance helper versus fight goal, stock/wear, memory, witnesses or threat consumers; stable address versus cached committed outcome; named clock period versus actual calendar; compact episode retention versus current truth. A generic resolver does not implement feints, gossip, memory fade or fight consequences by virtue of being callable. Supported actions need not roll merely because a chance seam exists. Luck can act through actual local means without a universal stat, and genuine chance/changed conditions follow CA12. Current AD51 permits first useful reuse; source calibration and memory byte budgets need actual selected inputs and measurements. No shared chance, memory, combat or crowd runtime was verified or changed here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: mechanism audit request, 2026-11-04 (B359)
folds.body:
This brief asks for mechanism-first reading of existing systems, missing upgrades and new capabilities; it is not the resulting audit or an execution order today. Preserve the requirement to inspect actual depth rather than infer capability from a module’s name. The listed family counts belong to the reviewed-row census and may overlap; do not sum them into unique newly unlocked steps or translate “a carrier exists” into source-faithful, reachable gameplay. Separate source-qualified action identity, actual means/cost/result, who learns what, and the native settlement consumer.

The requested lane order, source/data model split and weekly-window usage points were bounded planning assumptions, not guaranteed current costs or measured future capacity. Current host routing/authorization governs any worker. An estimate of step reach needs explicit matching scope and uncertainty; a new divination or brewing mechanism can help future worlds without making a universal framework prerequisite. Current lead-life laws and AD51 govern selected first seams. No private gap census, source claim, MF1 result or live implementation was inspected by reading this prompt, and none of its proposed lanes was dispatched.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: be-seat mapping evidence, 2026-11-04 (B359)
folds.body:
Retain the reported18-row old mapping, seven stale seat rows and3,444 whole-book lead rows as dated probe expectations/context. Blank observed cells are unperformed probes, not passes. The brief’s finite1–3 remap and1–24 generated range do not prove coverage of the whole book. Be-seat versus beside-seat control builders, walk IDs and intention waits require their actual consumers; a deterministic emitted ID alone does not establish visibility, affordability, source meaning, native execution or persistence.

Scene presence is not automatic dialogue availability, and a time gap is not always a legal wait without intervening decisions/support. Source-listed untaken choices are evidence routes, not necessarily locked controls or known character alternatives. Preserve explicit typed gaps and source rejection instead of using a superficially matching talk/walk as proof of the required action. Keep original private mappings and generate separately only in a selected run. Current private/public code and sealed-source boundaries apply; this historical coordinator-commit wording grants no present commit, worker or runtime authority. No mapping, script, DOM control or private source was executed or read here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: household verb mapping limits, 2026-11-04 (B359)
folds.body:
The9-act expectation, five-step threshold and pipeline counts are probe/workflow terms, not semantic completion. Preserve pack-supplied act IDs, actual place/object requirements, missing-householdActs fallback and explicit unmatched reasons. A household-looking verb can refer to distinct mechanisms; a matching object at the place is a proposed disambiguation default, not proof that the action’s intention, effects or custody match the source step. If two meanings remain materially different, retain that uncertainty rather than count a guessed route as faithful replay.

The no-pack regression and synthetic tests can protect generator behavior without proving native action admission, actual carried resources, source-qualified household coverage or save execution. Publication remains private for source mappings and name-free/synthetic for tracked code; recorded IDs/counts must still respect discovery boundaries. Existing X1/X2 script ownership and H1 runtime ownership are historical grants, not current releases. No pack, source row, generator, mapping, test or gameplay state was read or run by this content review.
